title: Dealer handling and unresolved issues
summary: This topic combines dealership handling, repair status, and a few unrelated owner remarks, with the clearest theme being complaints that prior fixes or dealer attempts did not resolve the problem.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe owners being told issues were already addressed or worked on by the dealer, yet the problems remained unresolved or were identified as defects.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention items being taken care of, delays for parts, visits or planned visits to the dealership, and a few isolated remarks without enough context to judge sentiment.

limitations: Most examples are too brief or context-free to determine sentiment confidently.
The cluster mixes dealership service status, parts delays, tire service, styling preference, and other remarks rather than one clearly coherent issue.
Samples are stratified and not representative of the full set of owner experiences.
